name: fixpay-native
description: Capacitor native shell for FixPay. Wraps the exact fixpay-pwa source (Vite mode "native") into installable iOS + Android apps.

scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.android: npm run build:web && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios && cap open ios
